events.verdict: Harden (LAC) briefly places his hand to Edwards' (MIN) shoulder and slides his hand off as changes directions during his drive.
Porter Jr. (LAC) legally contests McDaniels' (MIN) jump shot attempt.
Powell (LAC) briefly places his hand against Gobert's (MIN) hip as he sets the screen and immediately slides his hand off as they disengage.
Gobert (MIN) extends a forearm into Powell (LAC) and the contact initiated during his driving shot attempt is more than marginal.
Gobert (MIN) slightly extends his arm backward against Jones Jr.'s (LAC) side and Jones Jr. moves over the pick as they disengage.
Edwards (MIN) briefly places his forearm against Jones Jr.'s (LAC) prior to releasing away as they disengage.
Edwards (MIN) is in a legally obtained position when Zubac (LAC) steps backwards on to his foot. Zubac loses his balance as a result of the incidental contact.
Gobert (MIN) establishes himself in a screening position and releases away from Porter Jr. (LAC) as he moves toward the basket.
Edwards (MIN) extends his leg out as part of his shooting motion and incidental contact occurs to Porter Jr. (LAC) during his contest of the jump shot attempt.
Porter Jr. (LAC) places a slightly extended forearm against Edwards' (MIN) chest and marginal contact occurs as he moves under the screen.
Edwards (MIN) takes a step forward as he attempts to go for the ball during Powell's (LAC) drive to the basket and the body contact is marginal.
Harden (LAC) commits a take foul on Conley (MIN).
Porter Jr. (LAC) briefly places his hand against DiVincenzo's (MIN) waist and slides his hand off as he gathers the entry pass.
Powell (LAC) commits a take foul on Reid (MIN).
Edwards (MIN) briefly places his hand aganist Porter Jr.'s (LAC) torso and marginal contact occurs as he moves alongside of him in transition.
Jones Jr. (LAC) commits a take foul on Edwards (MIN).
Reid (MIN) initiates illegal contact with Jones Jr. (LAC) that affects his ability to receive the pass.
Gobert (MIN) touches the ball last before it goes out of bounds.
Harden (LAC) grazes Gobert's (MIN) arm as they come together underneath the basket and marginal contact occurs in pursuit of the rebound.
McDaniels (MIN) is in a legal guarding position during Harden's (LAC) jump shot attempt.
Reid (MIN) briefly places his hands against Dunn's (LAC) body and slides his hands off as they both pursue the loose ball.
Porter Jr. (LAC) moves toward DiVincenzo (MIN) and immediately disengages as marginal contact occurs during the rebound.
Reid (MIN) swipes his hand down against Porter Jr.'s (LAC) arm and initiates illegal contact contesting his layup attempt.
Randle (MIN) places his forearm against Powell's (LAC) chest and immediately slides his arm off as Powell attempts to gather the loose ball.
Zubac (LAC) briefly places his hand against Gobert's (MIN) shoulder and marginal contact occurs in the pursuit of the loose ball.
